invariants.rationale: The method always throws and never returns normally, so 'result' is never assigned; the only valid scenario for this program point is unreachable code, so result must be null.
The method implementation always throws an exception; thus, this method's exit is not reachable by any normal means.
The context parameter is required and is expected to be non-null at method entry and exit if reached.
extraMetadata is provided as a parameter and is assumed to be non-null at method entry and exit.
